_README: EXAMPLE / TEMPLATE. Copy to profile/expenses/categories.json and edit for your finances. This is the ONLY hand-authored expense file. scripts/expenses/categorize.py applies it to your transactions (SimpleFIN-synced + an optional Monarch/Mint CSV in imports/monarch/) to DERIVE profile/expenses/budget-data.json + summary.json; build_dashboard.py then renders reports/budget-dashboard.html. Never hand-edit the derived files. Precedence per transaction: descriptor_rules -> payee_overrides -> Monarch row's own category -> merchant-map inference -> needs_review. All account numbers/merchants below are placeholders.

taxonomy_types._doc: Map each category to a budget TYPE so the dashboard separates real consumption from internal money movement. spend=consumption | income | savings (transfers to savings/brokerage; inflows back are withdrawals) | transfer (internal/excluded, never spend) | tax | debt (loan/lease). Unlisted categories default to 'spend'.

descriptor_rules._doc: Highest priority. Case-insensitive SUBSTRING match against the raw bank descriptor (transaction 'description'); first match wins, so list specific patterns before general ones. This is how to split delivery services by the underlying store, which lives in the descriptor (e.g. 'IC* COSTCO BY INSTACART', 'DD *DOORDASH SPROUTS').

payee_overrides._doc: Applied after descriptor_rules, before the Monarch map. Resolves a merchant to one category. Key = normalized payee (lowercased, punctuation stripped). Use to fix merchants you categorize inconsistently or that a CSV mislabels.

needs_review_payees._doc: Payees the categorizer will NOT guess on — it leaves them uncategorized and lists them for you. Resolve by moving each into payee_overrides. Keep this lean.
needs_review_payees.unknown merchant example: is this a person, a store, or a transfer?

account_routing._doc: Which source owns each account's transactions, to avoid double-counting on the overlap window. SimpleFIN (live) for linked accounts from simplefin_start forward; an optional CSV (imports/monarch/) for dates before that AND for accounts you can't link live.
account_routing.exclude_note: Brokerage accounts (Buy/Sell/dividends) and any account that isn't spending — exclude from the budget.
account_routing.business_slugs_note: Transaction-store slugs (e.g. 'credit_card_1234') for business accounts to keep OUT of the personal budget.
